about: Labelled utterances for src/fast-path.js. `intent` is the tool the matcher must return, or null when the turn must fall through to the model. Positives are phrases a person would actually say to the clock, a calculator, memory, a task list and reminders; negatives are the neighbouring phrasings where a regex must not guess.
